newsitem.title: DENMARK: Near-static Danish bonds tread water ahead of Buba.
newsitem.headline: Near-static Danish bonds tread water ahead of Buba.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened more or less unchanged on Thursday in a market closely watching the Bundesbank's last council meeting before the summer holidays.
"The recnt weakening of the German mark could make the Bundesbank react by setting a possible variable repo rate but the chances are small," one dealer said.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was virtually unchanged from Wednesday's close at 114.38, with the yield at 5.82 percent. The forthcoming tone-setting seven percent 2007 bond stood at 107.26, yielding 6.03 percent.
The 2007's 10-year yield gap with the equivalent German bund was one basis point narrower at 52 bps.
The Danish crown traded at 3.8068 to the mark at 0730 GMT, more or less the same as Wednesday's late 3.8065.
